// bindprobe answers one question on the host it runs on: does an ESTABLISHED
// client socket whose local end is 127.0.0.1:P stop a listener from binding
// 127.0.0.1:P? It builds that hold exactly the way test/dolttest's
// holdPortWithClientSocket fixture (and internal/beads' copy of it) does: a
// sink listener, a probe-and-close port P, then a dial to the sink from local
// address 127.0.0.1:P. Then it tries:
//
//	A  net.Listen on 127.0.0.1:P with Go's defaults (Go sets SO_REUSEADDR on
//	   every listener; dolt is a Go program and listens the same way)
//	B  the same listen with SO_REUSEADDR cleared before bind
//	C  net.Listen with Go's defaults while a bound, unconnected, non-listening
//	   socket (no SO_REUSEADDR) holds 127.0.0.1:P instead
//	D  real `dolt sql-server -H 127.0.0.1 -P P` under the client-socket hold
//	E  real dolt under C's bound-socket hold
//
// Investigation ga-0ty53i8e (gascity gate tracker ga-2tucpj0k). Stdlib only:
// run it with `go run bindprobe.go` from any directory.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

var summary = map[string]string{}

func main() {
	summary["goos"] = runtime.GOOS
	summary["goarch"] = runtime.GOARCH
	summary["go"] = runtime.Version()
	fmt.Printf("bindprobe on %s/%s %s, uid %d\n\n", runtime.GOOS, runtime.GOARCH, runtime.Version(), os.Getuid())

	caseA()
	caseB()
	caseC()
	doltPath, err := exec.LookPath("dolt")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("dolt not on PATH: cases D and E not run")
		summary["D_dolt_client_hold"] = "not-run"
		summary["E_dolt_bound_hold"] = "not-run"
	} else {
		out, _ := exec.Command(doltPath, "version").CombinedOutput()
		fmt.Printf("dolt: %s (%s)\n", doltPath, strings.SplitN(strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), "\n", 2)[0])
		caseD(doltPath)
		caseE(doltPath)
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(summary)
	fmt.Printf("\nSUMMARY %s\n", data)
}

// clientHold is the fixture's hold: an established client socket whose local
// end is 127.0.0.1:port, connected to a sink listener on another port.
type clientHold struct {
	sink     net.Listener
	client   net.Conn
	port     int
	mu       sync.Mutex
	accepted []net.Conn
}

func newClientHold() *clientHold {
	sink, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	must("listen for the sink", err)
	h := &clientHold{sink: sink}
	go func() {
		for {
			c, err := sink.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			h.mu.Lock()
			h.accepted = append(h.accepted, c)
			h.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}()
	h.port = probePort()
	d := net.Dialer{LocalAddr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: h.port}}
	h.client, err = d.Dial("tcp", sink.Addr().String())
	must(fmt.Sprintf("hold port %d with a client socket", h.port), err)
	fmt.Printf("  hold: client socket %s -> %s (sink); client SO_REUSEADDR=%s\n",
		h.client.LocalAddr(), h.client.RemoteAddr(), sockopt(h.client.(*net.TCPConn), syscall.SO_REUSEADDR))
	if got := h.client.LocalAddr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port; got != h.port {
		fmt.Printf("  !! client local port %d is not the held port %d\n", got, h.port)
	}
	return h
}

func (h *clientHold) Close() {
	_ = h.client.Close()
	_ = h.sink.Close()
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	for _, c := range h.accepted {
		_ = c.Close()
	}
}

// writeOK reports whether the held client socket still takes a write.
func (h *clientHold) writeOK() string {
	if _, err := h.client.Write([]byte("x")); err != nil {
		return "write-failed: " + err.Error()
	}
	return "write-ok"
}

// boundHold binds a raw TCP socket to 127.0.0.1:port without SO_REUSEADDR and
// neither listens nor connects.
func boundHold() (fd, port int) {
	port = probePort()
	fd, err := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	must("raw socket", err)
	err = syscall.Bind(fd, &syscall.SockaddrInet4{Port: port, Addr: [4]byte{127, 0, 0, 1}})
	must(fmt.Sprintf("raw bind 127.0.0.1:%d", port), err)
	v, gerr := syscall.GetsockoptInt(fd, syscall.SOL_SOCKET, syscall.SO_REUSEADDR)
	fmt.Printf("  hold: raw socket bound to 127.0.0.1:%d, not listening, not connected; SO_REUSEADDR=%d (err %v)\n", port, v, gerr)
	return fd, port
}

func caseA() {
	fmt.Println("CASE A: client-socket hold, then net.Listen with Go defaults on the held address")
	h := newClientHold()
	defer h.Close()
	addr := net.JoinHostPort("127.0.0.1", strconv.Itoa(h.port))
	l, err := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("  listen %s: %v (EADDRINUSE=%v)\n", addr, err, errors.Is(err, syscall.EADDRINUSE))
		summary["A_default_listen"] = errClass(err)
		summary["A_client_after"] = h.writeOK()
		fmt.Println()
		return
	}
	defer l.Close()
	summary["A_default_listen"] = "bound"
	fmt.Printf("  listen %s: BOUND; listener SO_REUSEADDR=%s\n", addr, sockopt(l.(*net.TCPListener), syscall.SO_REUSEADDR))
	go func() {
		for {
			c, err := l.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			_ = c.Close()
		}
	}()
	c, derr := net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr, time.Second)
	if derr != nil {
		fmt.Printf("  dial %s: %v\n", addr, derr)
		summary["A_dial_listener"] = errClass(derr)
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("  dial %s: accepted (new connection %s -> %s)\n", addr, c.LocalAddr(), c.RemoteAddr())
		_ = c.Close()
		summary["A_dial_listener"] = "accepted"
	}
	summary["A_client_after"] = h.writeOK()
	fmt.Printf("  held client socket after the listener bound: %s\n", summary["A_client_after"])
	showSockets(h.port)
	fmt.Println()
}

func caseB() {
	fmt.Println("CASE B: client-socket hold, then a listen with SO_REUSEADDR cleared before bind")
	h := newClientHold()
	defer h.Close()
	addr := net.JoinHostPort("127.0.0.1", strconv.Itoa(h.port))
	lc := net.ListenConfig{Control: func(_, _ string, c syscall.RawConn) error {
		var serr error
		if err := c.Control(func(fd uintptr) {
			serr = syscall.SetsockoptInt(int(fd), syscall.SOL_SOCKET, syscall.SO_REUSEADDR, 0)
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return serr
	}}
	l, err := lc.Listen(context.Background(), "tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("  listen %s without SO_REUSEADDR: %v (EADDRINUSE=%v)\n", addr, err, errors.Is(err, syscall.EADDRINUSE))
		summary["B_listen_no_reuseaddr"] = errClass(err)
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("  listen %s without SO_REUSEADDR: BOUND (SO_REUSEADDR=%s)\n", addr, sockopt(l.(*net.TCPListener), syscall.SO_REUSEADDR))
		summary["B_listen_no_reuseaddr"] = "bound"
		_ = l.Close()
	}
	fmt.Println()
}

func caseC() {
	fmt.Println("CASE C: bound-unconnected hold, then net.Listen with Go defaults on the held address")
	fd, port := boundHold()
	defer syscall.Close(fd)
	addr := net.JoinHostPort("127.0.0.1", strconv.Itoa(port))
	l, err := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("  listen %s: %v (EADDRINUSE=%v)\n", addr, err, errors.Is(err, syscall.EADDRINUSE))
		summary["C_default_listen_bound_hold"] = errClass(err)
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("  listen %s: BOUND\n", addr)
		summary["C_default_listen_bound_hold"] = "bound"
		_ = l.Close()
	}
	fmt.Println()
}

func caseD(doltPath string) {
	fmt.Println("CASE D: client-socket hold, then dolt sql-server -H 127.0.0.1 -P <held port>")
	h := newClientHold()
	defer h.Close()
	summary["D_dolt_client_hold"] = runDolt(doltPath, h.port)
	summary["D_client_after"] = h.writeOK()
	fmt.Printf("  held client socket after dolt: %s\n\n", summary["D_client_after"])
}

func caseE(doltPath string) {
	fmt.Println("CASE E: bound-unconnected hold, then dolt sql-server -H 127.0.0.1 -P <held port>")
	fd, port := boundHold()
	defer syscall.Close(fd)
	summary["E_dolt_bound_hold"] = runDolt(doltPath, port)
	fmt.Println()
}

// runDolt starts dolt on port and reports "listening" when it accepts a
// connection and is still running a second later, or "exited" with its log.
func runDolt(doltPath string, port int) string {
	dir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "bindprobe-dolt-")
	must("dolt temp dir", err)
	defer os.RemoveAll(dir)
	dataDir := filepath.Join(dir, "data")
	rootDir := filepath.Join(dir, "root")
	must("mkdir data", os.MkdirAll(dataDir, 0o755))
	must("mkdir root", os.MkdirAll(rootDir, 0o755))
	logPath := filepath.Join(dir, "dolt.log")
	logFile, err := os.Create(logPath)
	must("dolt log", err)
	cmd := exec.Command(doltPath, "sql-server", "-H", "127.0.0.1", "-P", strconv.Itoa(port), "--data-dir", dataDir, "--loglevel", "warning")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "DOLT_ROOT_PATH="+rootDir, "DOLT_DISABLE_EVENT_FLUSH=true")
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = logFile, logFile
	must("start dolt", cmd.Start())
	_ = logFile.Close()
	exited := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { exited <- cmd.Wait() }()
	addr := net.JoinHostPort("127.0.0.1", strconv.Itoa(port))
	fmt.Printf("  dolt pid %d on %s\n", cmd.Process.Pid, addr)

	result := "timeout"
	deadline := time.Now().Add(20 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		select {
		case err := <-exited:
			fmt.Printf("  dolt EXITED: %v\n", err)
			printLog(logPath)
			return "exited"
		default:
		}
		c, derr := net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr, 200*time.Millisecond)
		if derr == nil {
			_ = c.Close()
			select {
			case err := <-exited:
				fmt.Printf("  dial ok, then dolt EXITED: %v\n", err)
				printLog(logPath)
				return "exited-after-dial"
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
			}
			fmt.Printf("  dial %s accepted and dolt still running 1s later: dolt LISTENS on the held port\n", addr)
			showSockets(port)
			result = "listening"
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	_ = cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM)
	select {
	case <-exited:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		_ = cmd.Process.Kill()
		<-exited
	}
	printLog(logPath)
	return result
}

func printLog(path string) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("  (dolt log unreadable: %v)\n", err)
		return
	}
	text := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
	if text == "" {
		fmt.Println("  dolt log: (empty)")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("  dolt log:")
	for _, line := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
		fmt.Printf("    | %s\n", line)
	}
}

// showSockets prints what the OS reports for TCP sockets on port.
func showSockets(port int) {
	if path, err := exec.LookPath("lsof"); err == nil {
		out, _ := exec.Command(path, "-nP", fmt.Sprintf("-iTCP:%d", port)).CombinedOutput()
		fmt.Printf("  lsof -nP -iTCP:%d:\n", port)
		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), "\n") {
			fmt.Printf("    | %s\n", line)
		}
	}
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		out, _ := exec.Command("netstat", "-an", "-p", "tcp").CombinedOutput()
		needle := fmt.Sprintf(".%d ", port)
		fmt.Printf("  netstat -an -p tcp | grep %q:\n", needle)
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(out), "\n") {
			if strings.Contains(line, needle) {
				fmt.Printf("    | %s\n", line)
			}
		}
	}
}

type syscallConner interface {
	SyscallConn() (syscall.RawConn, error)
}

func sockopt(c syscallConner, opt int) string {
	rc, err := c.SyscallConn()
	if err != nil {
		return "err:" + err.Error()
	}
	var v int
	var gerr error
	if err := rc.Control(func(fd uintptr) { v, gerr = syscall.GetsockoptInt(int(fd), syscall.SOL_SOCKET, opt) }); err != nil {
		return "err:" + err.Error()
	}
	if gerr != nil {
		return "err:" + gerr.Error()
	}
	return strconv.Itoa(v)
}

func probePort() int {
	l, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	must("probe a port", err)
	defer l.Close()
	return l.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
}

func errClass(err error) string {
	if errors.Is(err, syscall.EADDRINUSE) {
		return "EADDRINUSE"
	}
	return "error: " + err.Error()
}

func must(what string, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("FATAL %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
}
